# Perk — Design Notes

## Source

ColorLib "Coffee" — https://colorlib.com/wp/template/coffee/
Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/coffee/

## Design Tokens (extracted from main.css)

- Brand color: #b68834 (warm gold/amber) — used for buttons, accents, footer links
- Brand dark: #9a7230 (hover state)
- Background: #ffffff (white)
- Section bg: #f9f9ff (very light blue-gray)
- Text dark: #222222 (headings)
- Text muted: #777777 (body)
- Font: Poppins (300-700 weights)
- Button: pill shape (border-radius: 25px), gold background, white text
- Footer: dark background image, white text, gold accents

## Layout

- Hero: full-width background image, left-aligned content (col-lg-7)
- About: 2-column (video left, text right)
- Menu: 3-column grid, 3 rows = 9 items
- Gallery: asymmetric grid (2 left small, 1 large + 2 medium right)
- Reviews: 2-column cards + 4-column stats
- Blog: 2-column cards
- Footer: 3-column (About, Newsletter, Social)

## Images

- Use picsum.photos seeded placeholders for all images
- Hero background: dark coffee-themed (picsum with dark seed)
- Gallery: various coffee-related seeds
- Blog: lifestyle seeds
- Reviewer avatars: portrait seeds
